findings.message: the key that verified this trace's server signatures is the M1 placeholder anchor, whose private seed is published in this repository so the fixtures can sign with it. Anybody can mint a receipt or an acknowledgement under it, so a `key_source` of `pinned` says only that the signature matched a key everyone holds. Replacing the placeholder with the real organiser key is the release gate before any entry is judged. Reported at Pass because this run was made with `--dev`, where the placeholder is the expected anchor — the sentence stays in the document so a reader can tell this verdict from a strict one

3 record(s) and post(s) sit in the 300s arming window below `started_at` (2026-09-21T12:07:51Z). This is what a run arming itself looks like: the connector's arming signal is the harness's own first output, so the records that CAUSE the start receipt to be requested are chained before the request goes out. They carry no work — the baseline the receipt witnessed is seq 0, below all of them — so they are counted here rather than failed
